body: RULED 2026-10-07, his own statement, tightened and read back ("Yes, file it"): "The Octave is a map of my own regulation that I built without meaning to: eight stages describing how my brain actually runs, worked out before I knew AuDHD was a thing, at first by comparison with 'neurotypical' material we've since moved past. Its job now is to understand my mind's natural cadence, so I can manage my energy, avoid dysregulation, and know how to reregulate." His original words: "a system I unintentionally developed as an understanding of how I regulate, the figuring out that I was AuDHD before I even knew that was a thing… I now understand it on a deeper level of how I understand my mind and the natural cadence of my brain in an attempt to understand how to manage my energy to avoid dysregulation, and how to reregulate."
plain: The Octave is a map of JayArr's own regulation, built without meaning to, for managing his energy, avoiding dysregulation and knowing how to reregulate.
